Increase the inverter's bias current, through a wider NMOS (Wn), to raise gm. GBW scales roughly with gm/C_L, so about 1.6× gm is needed. Power has plenty of headroom: about 76 µW predicted at Wn ≈ 7 µm, against a 140 µW limit.
